command:
cd /app && md5sum merged_users.parquet conflicts.json > /tmp/before.md5 && python3 merge_users.py > /tmp/rerun.log 2>&1 && md5sum -c /tmp/before.md5 && echo "IDEMPOTENT_OK" && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
import pyarrow.parquet as pq
import pandas as pd

t = pq.read_table("/app/merged_users.parquet")
print("schema:", [(f.name, str(f.type)) for f in t.schema])
df = t.to_pandas()
print(df.to_string())
assert str(t.schema.field("user_id").type) == "int64", "user_id must be int64"
assert list(df.columns) == ["user_id","name","email","created_date","status"]
assert df["user_id"].is_unique and len(df) == 4
assert sorted(df["user_id"].tolist()) == [101,102,103,104]
for d in df["created_date"]:
    pd.Timestamp(d)  # validates parseability
    assert len(d) == 10 and d[4] == "-" and d[7] == "-", d

r = json.load(open("/app/conflicts.json"))
assert set(r) == {"total_conflicts","conflicts"}
assert r["total_conflicts"] == len(r["conflicts"]) == 3
for c in r["conflicts"]:
    assert set(c) == {"user_id","field","values","selected"}
    assert len(set(map(str, c["values"].values()))) > 1
    assert c["selected"] == c["values"]["source_a"]  # A present for all 3 conflicts

# semantic spot checks: B then C fallback for users absent from higher priority
row103 = df[df.user_id==103].iloc[0]
row104 = df[df.user_id==104].iloc[0]
assert row103["email"] == "bob@b.com" and row103["name"] == "Bob Wilson"
assert row104["email"] == "alice@c.com" and row104["created_date"] == "2024-04-01"
assert row103["status"] == "active" and row104["status"] == "active"
print("ALL_ASSERTIONS_PASSED")
EOF
